text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers improve by analyzing large amounts of data instead of following strict instructions. Deep learning, a more advanced method, uses layers of artificial neural networks to recognize complex patterns, like identifying faces in photos. You encounter AI every day: it recommends shows on streaming services, powers voice assistants like Siri, filters spam from your email, and helps doctors read medical scans. As AI becomes smarter, it continues to transform how we live and work.
